name: Generate executable Pocket custom contracts
ci_skip: requires a manually operated default-deny source-isolation wrapper plus operator-resolved protected roots; the automatic PR runner has no such adapter. Run explicitly outside CI with the isolation attestation, wrapper, and roots configured.

checks.check: Collect the two user-stated guarantees separately from inferred schema constraints and record them in CONTEXT.md.
Attach a named custom expectation to a declared source-aligned CSV input with relative model_paths, local-file csv-source, and a per-contract verifier script.
Attach a distinct named custom promise to the DuckDB output while retaining the ordinary schema promise.

Each referenced verifier has exactly one on_verify registration and an exact data_product.verify() __main__ guard; every custom contract owns one safe relative script path; no decorative contract scripts or secrets.
The structural custom-contract fixture checker must report ALL CHECKS PASSED.
